payload.title: MC-PCA on non-detrended speleothem data
payload.description: This workflow performs an analysis of speleothem oxygen isotope data using the Monte Carlo Principal Component Analysis (MC-PCA) method. It involves loading pre-existing data, separating records into sets, creating a geoseries object, applying MC-PCA, and visualizing the results.

steps.description: Import necessary libraries and load the speleothem data from pickle files.
steps.title: Import Libraries and Load Data

steps.description: Separate speleothem records into two sets for analysis, excluding certain records based on criteria such as length.
steps.title: Separate Speleothem Records

steps.description: Create a multiple ensemble geoseries object by slicing each timeseries at 3000 and 5000 years BP.
steps.title: Create Multiple Ensemble Geoseries Object

steps.description: Apply the Monte Carlo Principal Component Analysis (MC-PCA) to the multiple ensemble geoseries object.
steps.title: Apply MC-PCA

steps.description: Plot the results of the MC-PCA analysis to visualize the findings.
steps.title: Visualize MC-PCA Results
